planets.name: HD 3167 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 3167 with a 29.8-day year, found in 2016.

text.card: HD 3167 c was found in 2016 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around HD 3167. Its orbit and size follow Coy et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname COY_ET_AL_2026): disc_year 2016, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 4; pl_orbper 29.846511, pl_radj 0.26612589, pl_bmassj 0.03589987

quotes.title: HD 3167
quotes.card: The distance to HD 3167 can be determined from its annual parallax shift of 21.1363 mas as measured by the Gaia space observatory, yielding a range of 154 light years.
quotes.introduction: It has a relatively high proper motion, traversing the celestial sphere at the rate of 0.204″ per year.
